build_foil_classification_dataset: build a FoilClassificationDataset instance for visual language reasoning with cached tokenized entries
load_foil_annotations: load FOIL dataset annotations from a JSON file and build an index mapping image IDs to captions
tokenize_foil_entries: tokenize FOIL dataset captions with a BERT tokenizer and pad to a fixed sequence length
tensorize_foil_entries: convert tokenized FOIL dataset entries to PyTorch tensors for model input
get_foil_dataset_item: retrieve a dataset item from FoilClassificationDataset with image features, tokens, and classification target
